format.description: 'text' (default) for Markdown, 'json' for a structured response

plugin_path.description: Component (e.g. 'local_myplugin'), path relative to the Moodle root (e.g. 'local/myplugin'), or absolute path

component.description: Frankenstyle component of the plugin, such as local_myplugin

failed.description: Context files that could not be generated

error.description: Why the file could not be generated

file.description: Path of the file that failed to generate (relative to the Moodle root for global files, to the plugin for plugin files)

generated.description: Context files written by this call, relative to the plugin directory

path.description: Plugin directory relative to the Moodle root

skipped.description: Context files served from the cache because their sources did not change

type.description: Moodle plugin type, such as local or mod
